{{Nihongo|Daryl|グリル|Guriru|Grill}} is a villager in ''[[Harvest Moon DS]].''

'''Daryl''' is the valley's scientist. He lives in his laboratory near the turtle pond in the southern part of town. He conducts experiments and invents in his laboratory, but also spends a lot of time thinking about his work. He may be described as strange by some, but Daryl really isn't a bad guy. He has a secret crush on [[Flora (DS)|Flora]], and becomes envious if you marry her.

His laboratory's basement is home to the secret bachelorette [[Leia (DS)|Leia]], a mermaid who he nursed to health after she washed up on shore. You will need to befriend Daryl (to 100FP) in order to gain access to the basement of his laboratory if you wish to meet her.
